|notes=The Players Committee released Set 7 on 16 July 2004. [https://web.archive.org/web/20040922081946id_/http://swccgpc.com/interior.htm Release announcement]. The October revision adds the requirement that Bane be at a battleground to protect the existing same and related planet sites. The remaster restricts the geographic protection to here and the same site as Ree-Yees, removes the Firepower bonus and raises deploy to 3. Blaster Rifle stays a matching weapon and immunity remains below 3.
